Atomic material placement grammar

Bone: anatomy-informed cortical envelope + trabecular-rich interior (including marrow-capable region). Dental family: enamel, dentin, cementum, pulp candidates and separate periodontal interface. These are estimated spatial classifications, not atomic coordinates or measured internal tissue boundaries.

Motion-planning overlay

Guides mark approximate bilateral shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, and ankles on the front view. They are visual planning markers only; not confirmed skeletal articulations, fitted pivots, constraints, or physical joint centers. Geometry remains in original OBJ coordinates.
